paite: Kikaikhawm un, ahi, kikaikhawm un, zumna nei lou namte aw;
heading: Kisik Ding A Ngetna

paite: thupiak akuankhiak ma a, buhsi bang a hon mutmang ma in, na tung ua TOUPA hehna kihtakhuai ahong tun ma in, na tung ua TOUPA hehna ni ahong tun ma in kikaikhawm un.
Avaihawmna zui, nou lei a minunnem tengtengte aw, TOUPA zong un; diktatna zong un, migitna zong un; TOUPA hehna ni ah sel in na om kha thei uhi.
Gaza lah nutsiat in a-om dia, Ashkelon hihgawp in; suntang lai in Ashdod ahawlkhe ding ua, Ekron akizungkalh ding hi.
heading: Israel Kim A Namte Tunggikna

paite: Tuipi piau a teng Kereth namte aw na tung uh agik hi! TOUPA thu in noute ahon dem hi, Kanaan aw, Philistiate gam a teng om lou ding in ka hon hihgawp ding.
Huchi in tuipi, piaute louhing nou mun ahi ding a, belamchingte innte leh belamhonte ahuangte ahi ding hi.

Huai piau bel Judah inkuan khosuaksunte a ding ahi ding; huai ah abelamhonte uh avak ding uh; nitaklam in Ashkelon innte ah akual ding uh; TOUPA a Pathian un amaute aveh in, sal a atang uh pikhe nawn ding ahih ziak in.
Moab hon kouna leh Ammon tate gensiatna ka zata hi. Akigitpihte uh tung a kiliansak a, ka mite gam dou asawm uhi.

Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian ka hin bang in, "Chihtaktak in Moab, Sodom bang ahi ding a, Ammon tate Gomorrah bang, lou bineite leh chikhukte mun sia asuakden ding a, ka mi omlaite'n alok ding ua, ka nam omlaite'n amaute aluah ding uhi.”
Sepaihte' TOUPA mite tung a akiletsak ua, akou ziak un, akisak-theihna ziak un sawi in a-om ding uhi.
Amaute tung ah TOUPA alauhuai ding a; lei pathiante tengteng kial in ahihbei chiang in michih in amau mun chiat leh namte' tuikulh gam tengteng nangawn in amah abe ding uhi.
Nou Ethiopiate leng, ka namsau a thah a om ding na hi uhi.
Huan ama'n mallam dou in akhut alikkhe ding a, Assuria ahihse ding; Nineveh akisegawp ding a, huchi in gamdai bang in akeu ding uh.

Alai ah belamte akual ding ua, namte ganta tengteng; vangawngsau leh sakuh achial tungnung ah agiak ding ua; tohlet ah a-aw in la asa ding uh; sangkilte ah siatgawpna a-om ding; sidar sing a nasepte ahihsiat ziak in.

Hiai khopi nuamsa pilvang loutak a teng a, "Alungtang a keimah ka hi, kei lou kuamah dang a-om kei," chi ahi; bangchidan a hong segawp a, gantate a dia kualna ding hi ahia; kuapeuh akiang a pai in anuihsan in, akhut alehkhum ding uhi.
